crossRefs.note: So David received from her hand that which she had brought him. Then he said to her, “Go up in peace to your house.…
Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.”
The priest said to them, “Go in peace. Your way in which you go is before Yahweh.”
He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.
He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”
He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”
Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be…
remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice.

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Then Eli answered, “Go in peace; and may the God of Israel grant your petition that you have asked of him.”
translations.bsb: “Go in peace,” Eli replied, “and may the God of Israel grant the petition you have asked of Him.”
translations.kjv: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.
translations.asv: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace; and the God of Israel grant thy petition that thou hast asked of him.
